title: Opening and father's parade band with second line
summary: Julius gives his name and address, then describes his father's band, which people followed in a second line, and his brothers' standing.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs
